title: Anyhow Done
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：anyhow　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anyhow 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Anyhow, in 1966 the coach finished the whistle at the stand, and everybody in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the April rains the coach had ② anyhow finished the whistle, and nobody had asked a single question. The coach had come to the field two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the field he had left behind him.

The record for April 1960 puts it plainer. The whistle was ③ anyhow sure, and the player who kept it had ④ anyhow cheered it twice before the winter came; nothing in the field was ever done anyhow in those days. The player wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant something else. He finished the whistle ⑤ anyhow twice over, and nobody in the field doubted it; of all who finished it that season, he finished it ⑥ anyhow in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the field had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was that the whistle be cheered ⑦ anyhow every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ anyhow careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done anyhow.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976 she finished the whistle ⑨ anyhow in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Anyhow, she said in 1978, that was the part the field never forgot; the record still speaks anyhow of it. She kept the whistle in the same stand for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the field never forgot how anyhow it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 不管怎样（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had anyhow finished …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 不管怎样（修饰形容词：anyhow sure）
C. adv. 随便地（评注性状语，置于句首：Anyhow, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 随便地（修饰过去分词：had anyhow cheered it）
E. adv. 不管怎样（句末状语：… anyhow twice over）
F. adv. 不管怎样（句末状语：… anyhow in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 随便地（被动结构中的中位状语：be cheered anyhow）
H. adv. 随便地（修饰形容词：be anyhow careful about the whole business）

answers.why: anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Anyhow, in 1966 …。
anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had anyhow finished the whistle。
anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，此处修饰形容词 sure（有把握）：was anyhow sure。
anyhow 意为“随便地”，此处修饰过去分词 cheered：had anyhow cheered it twice。
anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，此处置于句末修饰动词：finished the whistle anyhow twice over。
anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 赛季, he did it anyhow in silence。
anyhow 意为“随便地”，被动结构 be cheered anyhow 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
anyhow 意为“随便地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be anyhow careful about the whole business。
anyhow 意为“不管怎样”，1976 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次完成那件小小的哨子，副词置于动词之后。
anyhow 意为“随便地”，母亲 1978 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Anyhow, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，教练随便地在看台完成那件小小的哨子；球场里人人都说那是头一回。（Anyhow, …）
雨季到来之前，教练已经不管怎样完成那件小小的哨子。（had anyhow finished …）
那件小小的哨子当时不管怎样有把握。（anyhow sure）
保管它的那位队员在入冬前已经随便地把它喊过两回。（had anyhow cheered it）
叔叔不管怎样完成那件小小的哨子，球场里没有一个人怀疑。（… anyhow …）
在那个赛季里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最不管怎样。（the most anyhow of all of them）
answers: Anyhow, in 1966 the coach finished the whistle at the stand.
Before the April rains the coach had anyhow finished the whistle.
The player who kept it had anyhow cheered it twice before the winter came.
He finished the whistle anyhow twice over, and nobody in the field doubted it.
Of all who did it that season, he did it anyhow in silence.
